name: Irvine

neighborhoods.name: Woodbridge
neighborhoods.homes: townhomes, condos and large apartment villages around lakes

housing: Irvine is a master-planned city of villages; renters mostly live in large managed apartment communities, condos and townhomes in HOA developments.

tenantHelp.name: Community Legal Aid SoCal
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income Orange County renters

climate: Test the air conditioning and check windows and patio doors; the climate is mild, but inland summer heat and Santa Ana winds can be hard on seals and screens.
fact: Much of Irvine's apartment stock belongs to a few large landlords, so many renters sign standard company leases with set move-in and move-out procedures.
